name: Chicken and the Wolf
description: Tulsa's legendary Nashville hot chicken joint. Unbelievably crispy and juicy.

reviews.text: Absolute best hot chicken in Oklahoma. The heat levels are genuine and flavor is incredible.
Crispy skin, tender inside, perfect pickles. Can't get enough of their loaded hot fries!

directions: Located right off historical Route 66 / S Lewis Ave. Ample street parking available.
bestDishes: Wolf Hot sandwich with fries and extra comeback sauce.
bestTimes: Weekday lunch hours to avoid the weekend rush.
moreInfo: Brings the true heat of Nashville straight to the heart of Tulsa. Safe dog patio dining is welcomed.

name: Oppa House - Korean BBQ
description: Authentic tabletop grilling experience with premium cuts and side dishes.

reviews.text: Host and source from Google Maps: tabletop grill experience is flawless, premium cuts are super soft.
Flawless side dishes (banchan) and extremely helpful staff.

directions: Sourced via local Google Maps links.
moreInfo: Links directly to user's personalized Google Maps review.

name: Brando's Espresso Bar
description: Premium double-roasted espresso and warm pup cups.

reviews.text: Strongest flat white in the neighborhood. Extremely friendly baristas.

directions: Located in the heart of the arts district.
moreInfo: DOGS are welcomed warmly on the outdoor terrace.

name: Doggie Pub & Lounge
description: Local craft beers on tap with a wide outdoor yard for dogs.

reviews.text: Perfect spot to grab a draft beer while the dogs socialize.

directions: Accessible from Downtown Dallas via DART transit.
moreInfo: Large outdoor sandbox and custom dog treats menu.

name: The Howl Arena
description: Amphitheater hosting high-fidelity dog symphonies and sound art.

reviews.text: The acoustic engineering is spectacular. Visual projections match the music.

directions: Take I-490 Exit 15 to Monroe Ave.
bestDishes: Gourmet hot dogs & local soft pretzels.
moreInfo: Indoor-outdoor seating options with pet-friendly zones.

name: Pee-On-Fire-Hydrant Park
description: Pristine fields with over 50 mock fire hydrants. Zero admission cost.

reviews.text: Absolute heaven for dogs. Clean grass, fresh water bowls everywhere.

moreInfo: Entirely fenced area with double-gated safety entry system.
